text:
maya.nguyen: Heads-up — found AWS creds embedded in terraform state for repo infra/edge-cache. S3 path: s3://redwood-terraform-prod/edge-cache/terraform.tfstate. Not sure how long the keys are valid.
sec-bot: sec-bot: ALERT: secret-scanner flagged object terraform.tfstate (contains AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID). Incident INC-2026-457 created.
kevin_h: On it. Can you paste the Key ID and the surrounding lines (redact full secret if present)?
maya.nguyen: KeyID: AKIAZZZEXAMPLE. Snippet (redacted): `"access_key": "AKIAZZZEXAMPLE", "secret_key": "<REDACTED>"` — appears in the state for resource `aws_iam_access_key.pipeline_key`.
kevin_h: OK. Immediate plan: 1) revoke the access key, 2) create an ephemeral IAM role for CI, 3) rotate any KMS-encrypted data that referenced the creds. I'll take 1 & 2 now.
olivia: We should coordinate a 30-min maintenance window with platform so we can swap creds and restart any pods that use the pipeline role. Might affect Dedicated clusters if the pipeline triggers infra deploys.
jordan: CloudTrail shows that KeyID used from 2026-03-18T02:10Z -> 2026-03-18T02:43Z from EC2 i-0abc1234 (us-west-2). Could be a periodic job.
nina: I'll harden the backend: migrate TF state to S3 with forced KMS encryption + block public ACLs, add bucket policy to deny non-service-account writes. Also adding a pre-commit hook to detect `access_key` patterns.
kevin_h: Who can run KMS data key rotation for alias/alias/redwood-prod-kms? We need to rotate CMK-wrapped secrets used by the pipeline (secrets in SSM/Vault that were provisioned using that key).
olivia: I can run it. Confirm alias: `alias/redwood-prod-kms`. Will need ~15 min and a quick redeploy.
maya.nguyen: Quick note — no customer data seems exposed, just infra repo artifacts. I think this stays internal, but we should keep a tight timeline.
jordan: Suggest increasing CloudTrail and S3 audit retention for the affected bucket + snapshot logs for the last 90 days into a secure bucket. @nina can you grant eng-sre read to the trails?
nina: Granting now — done. Also added an ops note in the runbook pointing to `scripts/rotate-kms-keys.sh`.
sec-bot: sec-bot: Checklist updated on INC-2026-457: [revoke-iam-key, create-ephemeral-role, update-terraform-backend, rotate-kms-data-keys, tighten-rbac, increase-audit-retention].
kevin_h: After revoke I'll scan CloudTrail for `AccessKeyId=AKIAZZZEXAMPLE` and any `AssumeRole` events; will post findings here.
maya.nguyen: Also opening a ticket to restrict who can read TF state in S3 (least-privilege) and to mandate storing sensitive tfvars in Vault instead of plain state.
jordan: Long-term: migrate TF pipeline to Vault provider and adopt remote state locking + state scrubber step in CI to remove any plain-text creds before push.
nina: I'll schedule a small RFC for the Vault migration and the pre-commit hook; target next-week for infra team.
kevin_h: One more ops detail: add an automated alert when a TF state object contains patterns like `"secret_key"` or `"private_key"` so we can catch these earlier.
maya.nguyen: Thanks all. Please update INC-2026-457 with timestamps of revoke + rotation once done.
sec-bot: sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-457 status -> in_progress.
kevin_h: Revoked key at 2026-03-18T03:05Z. Running KMS rotation now. Will post completion.
